population_source: Modeled subdivision shares: 40% of each old state total by province land area and 60% by existing mapped settlement population ranks; 100% area if no ranked settlements. Retains a rural floor and reconciles each old state independently. Not local census counts. Historical GHSL cache rejected because its registration is not reliable for current geography. Demographic refinement remains a separate task.
